name: Luna Assistant Prime
validation_scope: static, unit and package validation; credentialed runtime and physical tests required
runtime_test_required: Confirm migration of an existing 0.3.x config entry
Exercise Google AI Task, Conversation, STT and TTS with a real API key
Exercise Azure STT and TTS with real Speech keys and matching regions
Confirm key rotation, cooldown and failover with at least two keys
Confirm daily/monthly budget blocking and persisted consumption after restart
Confirm Google Search returns current grounded information while HA control stays enabled
Confirm Atom output through the Assist Pipeline
Confirm external playback, completion callback and wake-word barge-in
